name: Acquisition Matrix Size 128-152
description: MY-RADS recommends acquired matrix size of 128-152 for DWI (before reconstruction). Siemens: 128-150, Philips: 128-152, GE: 128. (From the MY-RADS Myeloma Whole-Body MRI Guidelines schema.)
implementation:
# AcquisitionMatrix format: [freq_rows, freq_cols, phase_rows, phase_cols]
# Non-zero values indicate the actual dimensions
acq_matrix = value["AcquisitionMatrix"].iloc[0]

if acq_matrix is not None and len(acq_matrix) >= 4:
    # Extract non-zero dimensions
    freq_dim = acq_matrix[0] if acq_matrix[0] > 0 else acq_matrix[1]
    phase_dim = acq_matrix[2] if acq_matrix[2] > 0 else acq_matrix[3]
    
    matrix_min = min(freq_dim, phase_dim)
    matrix_max = max(freq_dim, phase_dim)
    
    if matrix_min < 128 or matrix_max > 160:
        raise ValidationWarning(f"Acquisition matrix should be 128-152. Found {freq_dim}x{phase_dim}")
